programme.title: Computer Science, BA (Hons) and MEng
programme.degree: BA (Hons) 3 years, or BA + MEng 4 years; UCAS G400; start October 2027; collegiate admission
programme.how_found: Course search on undergraduate.study.cam.ac.uk; /courses/computer-science redirects to the canonical BA/MEng page.
programme.notes: Entry requirements on the page are 'for entry in 2027 or deferred entry in 2028'. TMUA is required of all applicants (CSAT additionally at Peterhouse and Trinity). Department: www.cst.cam.ac.uk.

english.quote: IELTS Academic – normally a minimum overall grade of 7.5, usually with 7.0 or above in each element
extra_quotes: C2 Proficiency – accepted with a minimum overall score of 200, with no element lower than 185
english.notes: University-wide minimum for admission ('normally', 'usually'), applies to applicants not from a majority English-speaking country. For interview, IELTS 6.5 with no element below 6.0 is recommended. No TOEFL or Duolingo figure is published on this page; school-leaving qualifications with English at C1 also accepted.

value.value: A*A*A (A level); IB 41-42 points with 776 at Higher Level
value.description: Minimum offer level for Computer Science, 2027 entry: A level A*A*A; IB 41-42 with 776 HL. Colleges usually require A* in Mathematics and/or Further Mathematics. Grade threshold on the school qualification, not a GPA on a scale.

gpa.quote: Minimum offer level A level: A*A*A IB: 41-42 points, with 776 at Higher Level
gpa.notes: Course page 'Entry requirements' (for entry in 2027 or deferred entry in 2028). Other qualifications: 'Check which other qualifications we accept' (/apply/before/accepted-qualifications). TMUA mandatory, no published cut-off. Offers are conditional, set by the College.

deadline.quote: 15 October 2026 Deadline to submit your UCAS application (6pm UK time).
extra_quotes: 22 October 2026 Deadline to submit My Cambridge Application (6pm UK time).
deadline.notes: For a course starting in 2027 (page: 'Are you planning to start an undergraduate course at Cambridge in 2027?'). One UCAS deadline for all applicants (no separate international round); 6pm UK time. The date has already passed on the research date. My Cambridge Application by 22 October 2026; TMUA 12-16 October 2026.

tuition.quote: Chemical Engineering and Biotechnology; Computer Science; Engineering; Management Studies; Manufacturing Engineering; Natural Sciences; Psychological and Behavioural Sciences £46,872
extra_quotes: The fees below are for 2027 entry.
fees listed are per year and are fixed for the duration of the course
tuition.notes: Table 'International tuition fees for 2027 entry', Group 4. University tuition only: an annual College fee is charged in addition (amount varies by College, published in the 'Undergraduate tuition fees 2027-28' document, not quoted).

value.name: Cambridge Trust awards (Cambridge Commonwealth, European and International Trust)

scholarship_exists.quote: The Cambridge Trust offers awards to overseas students, including affiliated students, who have been accepted for admission by a Cambridge College.
scholarship_exists.notes: Means-tested ('All awards are means-tested'); applied for only after an offer; 'Few full undergraduate scholarships are available – most support is a partial contribution and is means-tested.' Also some College awards and country-specific schemes. NEED_BASED_POSSIBLE, not sized.

scholarship_international.quote: The financial support available for international undergraduates is limited but at Cambridge this includes College awards; Cambridge Commonwealth, European and International Trust awards; and country-specific scholarships.
scholarship_international.notes: Page is for international undergraduates; Trust awards are for overseas students holding an offer; awards by country listed on the Trust website (not opened).
